column2: The museum's aesthetic value comes from its simple lines and the way sunlight fills its halls.
column3: 博物館的美學價值來自簡潔的線條，以及陽光灑滿大廳的方式。
column5: aesth 是「感覺」：用感官覺得美的，就是 aesthetic

column2: Good concert hall acoustics let a whisper on stage reach the last row.
column3: 好的音樂廳聲學設計，能讓台上的低語傳到最後一排。
column5: acou 是聽：阿酷！聽起來超酷的聲音學

column2: The choreography for the festival opened with dancers moving in slow circles and ended in a rapid line.
column3: 節慶的編舞以舞者緩慢繞圈開場，並以快速排成一列收尾。
column5: choreo 是舞蹈 + graphy 書寫：把舞步「寫」出來

column2: The choreographer taught the dancers every step and changed the formation after the first rehearsal.
column3: 編舞者教舞者每一個步伐，並在第一次排練後更動了隊形。
column5: choreography 的 -er：幫舞者寫舞步的人

column2: A wealthy patron paid the young painter's rent for three years so he could finish his masterpiece.
column3: 一位富有的贊助人替這位年輕畫家付了三年房租，讓他能完成傑作。
column4: patron of the arts (藝術贊助人)
column5: patron 來自 pater 爸爸：像爸爸一樣照顧藝術家

column2: Under royal patronage, Haydn composed for decades without worrying about money.
column3: 在王室的贊助下，海頓作曲數十年，不必為金錢擔憂。
column5: patron 贊助人 + age：贊助人給藝術家的整套支持

column2: The sculpture, carved from a single block of marble, stands in the center of the plaza.
column3: 這件雕塑由單一塊大理石雕成，矗立在廣場中央。
column5: sculpt 是雕刻：拿刀把石頭刮成一個像

column2: The sculptor spent months chipping away at the limestone until a graceful horse appeared.
column3: 雕塑家花了好幾個月一點一點鑿去石灰岩，直到一匹優雅的馬現身。
column4: sculptor at work (工作中的雕塑家)
column5: sculpture 是作品，sculptor 是人，-or 像 actor 做事的人

column2: The temple wall displays a relief of marching soldiers that rises only slightly from the stone.
column3: 神殿牆上有一幅行軍士兵的浮雕，只從石面微微凸起。
column5: relief 本意是「抬起」：圖案從牆面被稍微抬起來

column2: In the lobby stands a marble bust of the school's founder, showing only his head and shoulders.
column3: 大廳裡立著學校創辦人的大理石胸像，只呈現他的頭部和肩膀。
column5: 胸像只有頭和胸口，像人從車窗探出半截身子

column2: The garden's statuary, dozens of marble figures along the paths, drew visitors from across the country.
column3: 花園裡的群雕，也就是沿著小徑排列的數十尊大理石人像，吸引了全國各地的遊客。
column5: statue 雕像 + ary 一整批：一大群雕像

column2: The bronze statue stood on a granite pedestal so tall that visitors had to look far upward.
column3: 銅像立在花崗岩基座上，基座高到遊客必須仰得很高才看得到。
column4: stand on a pedestal (立於基座上)
column5: ped 是腳：雕像的腳踩著的那個台座

column2: The stone arch carries the weight of the bridge down to the supports on either side.
column3: 這座石拱把橋的重量傳到兩側的支柱上。
column5: arch 像弓 arc 的彎形：彎彎的弓形撐住上面的重量
column8: 拱門；拱券；力學承重結構

column2: The dome of the cathedral rises above the city like a giant stone bowl turned upside down.
column3: 大教堂的圓頂像一個倒扣的巨大石碗，高高聳立在城市上方。
column5: dome 就是倒扣的大碗，罩住整座教堂

column2: Stone ribs cross under the vault, spreading the weight of the roof across the walls.
column3: 石肋在拱頂下交叉，把屋頂的重量分散到牆壁上。
column5: vault 像把屋頂「翻」成弧形，跳馬 vault 也是跳出弧線

column2: Tall marble columns support the porch roof of the old courthouse.
column3: 高大的大理石石柱支撐著老法院門廊的屋頂。
column5: column 的 n 不發音，唸 colum；一根柱子像 I

column2: Carvers decorated each capital with leaves, so every column ended in a tiny stone garden.
column3: 雕刻工人用葉片裝飾每個柱頭，使每根柱子頂端都像一座小小的石頭花園。
column5: capital 來自拉丁文 caput「頭」：柱子的頭

column2: Gods and heroes are carved into the pediment above the temple's front columns.
column3: 神與英雄被雕刻在神廟正面柱列上方的三角山牆上。
column5: 想像神廟柱子戴著一頂三角形的帽子

column2: A frieze of dancing figures runs like a ribbon around the top of the temple wall.
column3: 一條舞動人像的橫飾帶，如緞帶般環繞在神殿牆壁頂端。
column5: frieze 像 freeze 凍結：一排凍結在牆上的人影

column2: The building's glass facade reflects the clouds, hiding the busy offices behind it.
column3: 這棟建築的玻璃外牆映出雲朵，掩藏了後方忙碌的辦公室。
column5: facade 和 face 臉同家族：建築的一張臉

column2: Sunlight pours through the glass roof into the atrium, where visitors gather beside a small fountain.
column3: 陽光穿過玻璃屋頂灑進中庭，遊客聚集在小噴泉旁。
column5: atrium 諧音「愛醉人」：中庭陽光好，愛醉人
column8: 中庭；天井；羅馬採光庭院

column2: Worshippers filled the nave, the long central hall of the church, long before the service began.
column3: 禮拜開始許久之前，信眾就坐滿了教堂中央的長正廳。
column5: nave 和 navy 同源 navis 船：教堂倒過來像大船
column8: 教堂正廳；中央主殿長廊

column2: Guests walked down the aisle between two rows of chairs to reach their seats.
column3: 賓客沿著兩排椅子之間的走道走向座位。
column4: walk down the aisle (走下走道)
column5: aisle 的 s 不唸，唸「愛兒」；island 的 s 也不唸

column2: The transept crosses the nave at a right angle, giving the cathedral the shape of a cross.
column3: 耳堂與正廳呈直角交叉，使大教堂呈現十字形。
column5: trans 橫越 + sept 圍場：橫跨在主殿旁的翼

column2: Behind the altar, the apse curves like a half circle and holds the bishop's chair.
column3: 祭壇後方的後殿呈半圓形，裡面放著主教的座椅。
column5: apse 唸 aps：像一個躺下來的半圓形 C

column2: A thick stone buttress leans against the cathedral wall to keep it from falling outward.
column3: 一道厚重的石扶壁靠在大教堂牆邊，防止牆向外傾倒。
column5: but 頂 + tress：牆想往外倒，它用力頂住

column2: Flying buttresses arch from the cathedral's upper wall to outer piers, letting builders add tall windows.
column3: 飛扶壁從大教堂上層牆壁拱向外側墩柱，讓建築工人得以開設高大的窗戶。
column5: flying 飛 + buttress 扶壁：像飛過空中的手臂撐住牆
column8: 飛扶壁；哥德教堂輕盈力學

column2: The church spire rises so high that it can be seen from every village in the valley.
column3: 教堂尖塔高聳，山谷裡每個村莊都看得到。
column5: spire 像 spear 矛：尖尖地刺向天空
column8: 尖塔；哥德教堂刺天尖頂

column2: Every hour the bells in the belfry rang across the sleepy village.
column3: 每個整點，鐘樓裡的鐘聲響遍沉睡的村莊。
column5: bel 像 bell 鐘 + fry：鐘聲響得像鍋裡滋滋作響

column2: Gothic cathedrals use pointed arches and tall windows to make visitors look toward the sky.
column3: 哥德式大教堂以尖拱與高窗，讓訪客的視線望向天空。
column5: 哥德諧音「高的」：又高又尖的教堂

column2: Romanesque churches have thick walls and round arches, which keep them sturdy but dark inside.
column3: 羅馬式教堂有厚牆與圓拱，使建築堅固，但內部昏暗。
column5: Roman 羅馬 + esque 像：像羅馬人蓋的圓拱厚牆

column2: The Byzantine church glows with gold mosaics beneath a wide dome.
column3: 拜占庭式教堂在寬闊的圓頂下閃耀著金色馬賽克。
column5: 拜占庭諧音「比贊挺」：金光閃閃的圓頂，大家都讚

column2: The old castle's masonry has survived storms because every stone was cut and fitted with great care.
column3: 老城堡的石造工程歷經風暴而屹立，因為每塊石頭都經過精心切割與接合。
column5: mason 石匠 + ry：石匠做出的整面牆

column2: Builders spread wet mortar between the bricks so the wall would hold together as it dried.
column3: 建築工人在磚塊之間抹上濕砂漿，使牆乾燥後能黏在一起。
column5: mortar 也指研缽：在缽裡攪拌混合，砂漿也是拌出來的

column2: Archaeologists can tell the age of a village from the style of its broken pottery.
column3: 考古學家可以從破碎陶器的樣式判斷一個村落的年代。
column5: pot 壺 + tery：做壺的工藝與成品

column2: She studies ceramics and has learned to shape clay, glaze it, and fire it in a kiln.
column3: 她研習陶瓷藝術，學會將黏土塑形、上釉，再放進窯裡燒製。
column5: ceramic 是陶瓷：碗盤、花瓶都是用它做的

column2: The thin porcelain cup was so delicate that light glowed through its white walls.
column3: 這只薄瓷杯非常精緻，光線可以透過它白色的杯壁透出來。
column5: porcelain 諧音「破是蘭」：又白又薄，一碰就破

column2: The potter dipped the bowl in glaze before firing it, giving it a smooth, shiny blue surface.
column3: 陶工在燒製前把碗浸入釉藥，使它擁有光滑發亮的藍色表面。
column5: glaze 像 glass 玻璃：燒出一層玻璃般的光

column2: The potter slid the clay bowls into the kiln, which was heated to over a thousand degrees.
column3: 陶工把黏土碗推進窯爐，窯爐被加熱到超過一千度。
column4: fire in a kiln (在窯中燒製)
column5: kiln 的 n 不發音，彷彿被窯裡的火燒掉了

column2: Roofs covered with terracotta tiles glowed orange in the evening sun across the Spanish village.
column3: 西班牙村莊鋪著紅陶瓦的屋頂，在傍晚陽光下泛著橘光。
column5: terra 土地 + cotta 烤熟：烤熟的土
